verdict.rationale: The evidence covers platform seller onboarding, fee monetization, and seller payouts. Nothing documents splitting a single charge among multiple sellers, or reversing or adjusting a split, as API objects. Fee monetization and payout management are adjacent features, not the split-charge routing capability this story requires.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split one charge among any set of parties — route funds to multiple sellers, take my cut, and reverse or adjust the split later, all as first-class API objects
